debt_gdp.label: Central government debt, % of GDP (World Bank) (DEBTTLCHA188A)

fdi.label: FDI net inflows, % of GDP (World Bank)

gdp_real.label: Real GDP, chain-linked volume, seasonally adjusted (SECO via OECD quarterly national accounts, T0102)

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth, QoQ, seasonally adjusted (derived from SECO real GDP via OECD quarterly national accounts)

gdp_real_annual.label: Real GDP, trailing 4-quarter sum (derived from SECO real GDP via OECD quarterly national accounts)

gdp_level.label: GDP, current prices, calendar year (sum of seasonally adjusted quarters; SECO via OECD quarterly national accounts, T0102)

business_confidence.label: Business confidence indicator, LT avg = 100 (OECD BCICP)

cpi.label: CPI, all items, YoY (OECD live prices system)

cpi_mom.label: CPI, all items, MoM (OECD live prices system)

population.label: Population, total, mid-year estimate, annual (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL)

gdp_per_capita.label: GDP per person, current prices, calendar year (GDP divided by World Bank population)
